summary: Largo Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a Material Change Report regarding its subsidiary Largo USA receiving a $60.1 million firm-fixed-price delivery order from the U.S. Defense Logistics Agency for high-purity vanadium pentoxide under a five-year IDIQ contract. This is a routine supply contract, not a special situation. No board recommendation, advisors, or structural deal terms are involved. The contract has a fixed price per pound with a 10% annual escalation; the IDIQ does not guarantee minimum orders. Monitor for future delivery orders.
